verdict.rationale: Framer documents a built-in AI agent that takes plain-language descriptions and changes the project directly. It applies styles, colors and fonts across the site, adapts layouts for breakpoints, wires interactions and manages the CMS, with conversational refinement. External agents such as Claude Code and Cursor can also operate the project. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the agent follows commands, and evidence that publishing and site settings can also be driven by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe the look you want. The agent takes care of colors, fonts, component styles, motion and effects across your site.
Keep refining in the conversation, or take over on the canvas at any point.
It adapts your layouts across breakpoints, adjusting stacks, type sizes, spacing, and image crops until everything works.
just describe what you want. The agent handles the wiring so you can focus on the design, not the how-to.
The CMS agent sets up, organizes, and updates your entire CMS, connecting it directly to the canvas so content and design stay in sync.
Connect Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor to update a Framer project.
